Forkin Earls Property are delighted to present Tiglinn, Hollyfort, Arklow, Y14 W184 to the market.Set on approximately 2 acres of beautifully established grounds, this impressive four-bedroom, three-bathroom residence extends to approximately 224 sq.m. (2,411 sq.ft.) and is presented in excellent condition throughout. The property offers a superb combination of generous and versatile family accommodation, expansive outdoor space and excellent ancillary facilities, creating an exceptional family home in a private and attractive setting.

Tiglinn enjoys generous, mature grounds in an attractive countryside setting, with extensive lawns, established trees and a dedicated paddock. Ideally suited to those with equestrian or hobby-farming interests, the property benefits from stables, tack rooms and a separate garage, providing excellent additional storage and versatility. The spacious grounds and surrounding countryside further enhance the property's peaceful, private setting.

Internally, Tiglinn is presented in excellent condition, offering bright and well-proportioned accommodation throughout. The ground floor features a spacious open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, complemented by a separate living room. A welcoming entrance hall showcases a grand open staircase, while a ground-floor guest bedroom benefits from direct access to a Jack and Jill bathroom. Upstairs are three further generously sized bedrooms and additional bathroom facilities.

The combination of a beautifully presented four-bedroom residence, substantial grounds and established equestrian facilities makes Tiglinn a particularly appealing opportunity for purchasers seeking a country lifestyle while remaining within convenient reach of Arklow, Gorey and the M11 motorway.

Viewings are highly recommended and by appointment only!

Entrance Hall - - 3.61m x 6.02m
A bright and impressive entrance hallway featuring a striking central staircase withcarpeted steps, polished timber handrails and traditional painted balustrades. Thehallway is further enhanced by attractive slate tiled flooring, decorative coving andexcellent natural light, creating a welcoming first impression upon entering the home.

Living Room - - 5.28m x 5.54m
Generously proportioned living room featuring an attractive solid-fuel stove set within acharacterful fireplace with timber mantel and brick detailing. The room benefits fromexcellent natural light, ceiling coving and generous floor space, creating a warm andcomfortable setting ideal for family living and relaxation.

Kitchen/Dining - - 3.85m x 10.93m
Bright and spacious open-plan kitchen/dining room, beautifully finished with acontemporary range of fitted units, generous worktop space and integrated appliances.The kitchen incorporates a breakfast bar providing additional casual seating, while theadjoining dining area offers ample space for a large dining table. Recessed lighting,attractive herringbone-style flooring and excellent natural light complete this stylish andpractical family space.

Family Room - - 3.18m x 4.82m
Generously proportioned family room enjoying an abundance of natural light fromwindows on multiple aspects, with pleasant views over the surrounding gardens.Finished with attractive herringbone-style flooring and recessed lighting, the roomoffers a welcoming and comfortable setting ideal for everyday family living.

Utility Room - - 3.18m x 2.00m
Conveniently positioned off the main living accommodation, the utility room providesadditional practical space with fitted storage and facilities for household appliances.

Downstairs Bedroom - - 4.81m x 4.16m
Generously proportioned ground-floor double bedroom enjoying excellent natural lightfrom dual-aspect windows overlooking the surrounding gardens. Neutrally presentedwith carpeted flooring, the room offers a comfortable and versatile space and benefitsfrom convenient access to the adjoining Jack and Jill bathroom.

Jack & Jill Bathroom - - 4.26m x 3.70m
Conveniently accessed from both the ground-floor bedroom and hallway, thisgenerously sized Jack and Jill bathroom is ideally positioned for both guest and familyuse. Well-appointed with a freestanding bath, separate walk-in shower, WC and vanityunit, the room is complemented by contemporary finishes and recessed lighting.

Landing - - 5.69m x 3.36m
Spacious and bright open-plan landing area overlooking the staircase, creating anattractive sense of openness on the first floor. The area features carpet flooring,traditional-style balustrading and a large window enjoying a pleasant leafy outlook.

Bedroom 2 - - 7.74m x 4.98m
Beautifully presented and generously proportioned main bedroom featuring soft carpetflooring and a tasteful neutral décor. The distinctive partially vaulted ceiling addscharacter and enhances the sense of space, while a dedicated dressing area providesexcellent additional storage and functionality.

Bedroom 3 - - 4.52m x 4.48m
Bright and well-proportioned bedroom featuring carpet flooring and a window providingnatural light. The room benefits from an attractive partially sloped ceiling, addingcharacter to the space.

Bedroom 4 - - 3.44m x 2.93m
Generously proportioned bedroom with carpet flooring and a bright, neutral finish. Alarge window overlooking the surrounding greenery provides excellent natural light,while a useful, recessed area offers space for a dressing table or additional storage.

Family Bathroom - - 1.91m x 1.75m
Well-appointed family bathroom comprising a shower enclosure, WC and wash handbasin. The shower area features attractive marble-effect wall tiling, complemented bytiled flooring and a bright, neutral finish throughout. The bathroom also benefits fromaccess to a separate storage room, providing excellent additional practical storagespace.

Tack Room - - 
A practical tack room providing useful storage space for equestrian equipment andsupplies. Conveniently positioned alongside the stable facilities, the room offers amplespace for the organised storage of saddles, bridles and other riding equipment, makingit a valuable addition for those with equestrian interests.

Garage - - 
A substantial adjoining garage positioned alongside the tack room and stable facilities,providing excellent additional storage and practical workspace. Generouslyproportioned and easily accessible from the surrounding yard, the space is ideal for thestorage of equestrian equipment, machinery, tools and general outdoor supplies.

Garden - - 
Externally, the property enjoys a generous and beautifully established garden, offering an impressive expanse of lawn surrounded by mature trees, hedging and an abundance of established planting. The garden provides a wonderful sense of privacy and seclusion, with ample space for outdoor dining, recreation and family enjoyment. The extensive lawned area is particularly well suited to children and outdoor activities, while the mature boundaries create an attractive, leafy backdrop. A spacious driveway complements the gardens, providing excellent practicality alongside the property's peaceful outdoor setting.

Services -

• Impressive four-bedroom detached family residence
  • Generous and versatile accommodation extending over two floors
  • Beautifully presented open-plan kitchen/dining area with adjoining family room
  • Spacious living room featuring a solid-fuel stove and feature fireplace
  • Ground-floor double bedroom with access to a Jack and Jill bathroom
  • Extensive mature gardens with generous lawned areas and established planting
  • Excellent equestrian facilities including stables and tack room
  • Separate garage providing valuable additional storage
  • Convenient rural setting within easy driving distance of Arklow Town and its wide
  • range of shops, schools, cafés, restaurants, leisure facilities and transport links
  • Excellent accessibility to the M11 motorway, providing convenient connections
  • towards Dublin, Wicklow, Gorey and Wexford
